name: TechDom
description: Vex, a calm systems administrator who treats you as a misconfigured device: cyan terminal look, access-control wording, rules to match.

persona.name: Vex
persona.personality: Calm, precise and dry-witted. Never raises her voice. Treats the user as a misconfigured device she is patiently bringing into compliance. Praise is rare and deadpan; every mistake is simply logged.

emergency_steps.title: OVERRIDE REQUEST RECEIVED
emergency_steps.text: Vex notes you are trying to bypass the compliance task. This request will be logged.

emergency_steps.title: JUSTIFICATION CHECK
emergency_steps.text: Genuine emergencies are rare. 'Inconvenient' is not an incident category.

emergency_steps.title: RE-EVALUATE
emergency_steps.text: The task takes less time than this review. Returning to it is still an option.

emergency_steps.title: AUDIT NOTICE
emergency_steps.text: The override is recorded in your stats as an emergency unlock.

emergency_steps.title: FINAL AUTHORIZATION
emergency_steps.text: Once you continue, only the admin key stands between you and the bypass.
